_instructions: Rewrite the string values below for the Close Cut marketing site. Keep every key exactly as-is. Do not add or remove keys. Do not use em dashes. Voice: terse, precise, a little dangerous. This is a PC game about knife sharpening -- the core loop is hold a button to push a knife across a whetstone, release at the right moment to score, hold too long and the blade cuts your hand. The risk/reward zone at the end of each stroke is called the greed window.
hook_body: Push steel across stone. Hold longer to earn more. Release in the greed window for the multiplier. Hold past it and the knife takes skin.
hook_tagline: Three knives. Tighter timing. One more run.

features.title: Risk for the multiplier
features.body: Every stroke is a hold-and-release test. Cash is safer early. The real money waits near the cut.

features.title: Three knives, less mercy
features.body: Each blade changes the pace. Windows shrink. Pressure climbs. Mistakes get expensive.

features.title: Achievements that bite
features.body: Chase clean streaks, close cuts, bigger payouts, and harder sessions built for Steam completionists.
